headline: Bitcoin ETFs lost money for a second straight day on Friday and bitcoin sits just below its 50-day average, with the Fed decision, US growth and inflation data and Coinbase earnings all due next week.

market.asOf: Snapshot from news reports, not a live feed: BTC $80,806 on Saturday morning 24 Oct per CryptoTicker; ETH about $2,380 per Crypto.com's weekend update; SOL about $102, down 2%, per CaptainAltcoin (about 06:00 UTC, 13:00 Bangkok). Price pages and the Fear & Greed index could not be read this run. Live prices are at the top of the page.

stories.title: Bitcoin ETFs lose money for a second straight day
stories.summary: US spot bitcoin ETFs, funds that hold bitcoin for stock-market investors, saw another $137.9 million leave on Friday 23 Oct after a $635.6 million outflow on Thursday. Earlier inflows mean the week as a whole still ended slightly positive.
points: Friday's net outflow was $137.94M, led by BlackRock's IBIT (-$110.34M) and Fidelity's FBTC (-$31.78M); Morgan Stanley's MSBT took in $4.19M, per SoSoValue data reported by Bloomingbit.
Thursday's $635.6M outflow was the largest daily outflow since June, per The Block.
Before Thursday the week had inflows of $526.7M on Monday, $23.2M on Tuesday and $528.4M on Wednesday, per The Block.
The full week ended about +$301M net, per SoSoValue figures cited by Crypto.com.
Spot ether ETFs took in $4.35M on Friday after losing $110.5M on Thursday, per Bloomingbit.

sources.label: The Block: Bitcoin ETFs swing back to net outflows

stories.title: Bitcoin sits below its 50-day average for a second day ahead of the Fed
stories.summary: Bitcoin has slipped under its 50-day moving average, a widely watched trend line, after staying above it for more than two months. Oil near six-month highs keeps worries about inflation and higher interest rates alive before Wednesday's Fed decision.
points: Bitcoin was $80,806 against a 50-day average of $81,807 on Saturday morning, a second straight day below that line after 66 straight days above it, per CryptoTicker.
The 24-hour range was $80,455 to $81,939, per CryptoTicker.
Brent crude is at $116.72, a six-month high, and the 10-year US Treasury yield is about 4.99%, per Crypto.com.
More than $470M of leveraged crypto trades were liquidated in 24 hours, per Crypto.com.
The Fed holds rates at 3.75-4.00% after a September hike; 94 of 100 economists in a Reuters poll expect a hold on Wednesday, per Crypto.com.

sources.label: CaptainAltcoin: Why is crypto down today, 24 Oct

stories.title: Phantom wallet starts offering Kalshi prediction markets to US users
stories.summary: Phantom, a popular self-custody crypto wallet, began rolling out Kalshi's regulated event contracts to US users on Friday. Users must verify their identity with Kalshi, and some categories are blocked in certain states.
points: Access is rolling out gradually over the coming weeks; trades are funded with Phantom's CASH stablecoin, per The Block.
The fee is $0.02 per contract plus a network fee, per The Block.
Kalshi has handled more than $291B of volume this year, per The Block.
Sports contracts are blocked in Michigan; Nevada also blocks elections, politics and entertainment, per The Block.

sources.label: The Block: Phantom rolls out Kalshi prediction markets

briefs.title: US bank regulator publishes its final stablecoin rule
briefs.summary: The OCC's rule implementing the GENIUS Act, covering reserves, redemption, custody and licensing, appeared in the Federal Register on 23 Oct and takes effect 18 Jan 2027.

briefs.title: Tether says it found no wrongdoing as a senator seeks records on payments to Bo Hines' firm
briefs.summary: Sen. Blumenthal is asking about roughly $6.3M paid to Nxum; Tether says an external-counsel review found no evidence of wrongdoing, per FinanceFeeds.

briefs.title: Initia's network is still halted after an exploit
briefs.summary: The attacker minted 2M unbacked AUSD and holds about 1,135.5 ETH (about $2.73M); no restart or confirmed loss figure had been announced, per Cointelegraph.

briefs.title: New York seeks $1.37B from NovaTech founders
briefs.summary: The state attorney general wants $1.13B in disgorgement plus $232.5M in interest over an alleged pyramid scheme that took in $1.16B of crypto deposits, per The Block.

briefs.title: Kraken withdraws questionnaires sent to Monero users
briefs.summary: Co-CEO Arjun Sethi apologized for emails asking XMR customers about their employer and planned use of funds, calling them an internal mistake, per Crypto Adventure.

briefs.title: Netanyahu orders a blockchain plan for Israel
briefs.summary: The plan is meant to help the economy withstand possible sanctions and banking restrictions; no chain or timeline was given, per The Block.

briefs.title: Bitcoin miner Bitdeer sold all the bitcoin it mined last week
briefs.summary: Bitdeer sold all 283.4 BTC mined in the week to 23 Oct and holds no bitcoin on its balance sheet, per PANews via Phemex.
